observations: Photo 0 shows a packaged Itel TV/DVD Guard surge protector in a red and white blister pack. The front label reads 'itel', 'TV/DVD Guard', '6s Wait Time', and shows icons for TV and car. The unit has a white body with a 3-pin socket and a black top panel with 'OFF', 'WAIT', 'ON' indicators.

Photo 1 shows the same unit out of packaging, against a white background. The top panel clearly shows 'itel' logo, 'TV/DVD GUARD', '6sec Delay / 13AMPS', and three indicator lights labeled OFF, WAIT, ON. The 3-pin socket is visible below.

Photo 2 shows the back of the packaging. The label reads 'itel ELECTRICS', 'Safer Electrics, Safer Home', and lists protected devices: 'Photovoltaic / Fan / TV&Video / NB / Laptop / Sensitive Devices / Mobile Phones / All Electronic Equipment'. A barcode and model number 'ISU-6100W' are visible at the bottom.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show the product labeled as 'itel TV/DVD Guard' and 'ISU-6100W', with packaging claiming protection for electronics.
Photo 1 clearly shows '6sec Delay / 13AMPS' on the front panel of the unit.

claims.claim: Protects Photovoltaic, Fan, TV&Video, NB, Laptop, Sensitive Devices, Mobile Phones, All Electronic Equipment

risks.risk: The surge protector may be non-functional or have degraded surge protection components.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit being plugged in and the indicator lights changing from OFF to ON after a delay, and a test with a multimeter or surge tester.

risks.risk: The product may be counterfeit or not meet safety standards.
risks.proof: A close-up of the barcode and model number scanned, and a photo of the internal components if possible.

proof_requests: A video showing the unit being powered on and the indicator lights functioning.
A close-up of the barcode and model number scanned.
A photo of the internal components if possible.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Itel ISU-6100W surge protector with visible branding and model number. All seller claims are supported by the photos. Hidden risks include functionality and authenticity, which are priced conservatively until proven.
